text.en:
of Executive Order No. 91, dated February 5,
1946, entitled "Fixing new ceiling prices of all commodities

OFFICIAL GAZETTE
and for other purposes," is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 6. There is hereby created a Price Fixing Committee to be
composed of the Secretary of Commerce and Industry as Chairman,
she Secretary of Labor, the Secretary of Health and two represen-
tatives of the duly organized chambers of commerce in the City of
Manila, as Members. The Price Fixing Committee shall have the
power to increase or decrease the price ceiling herein specified, of
provide a higher or lower mark-up for wholesalers or retailers, de-
pending upon changes in the cost of production, manufactare, trans-
portation, and other factors affecting prices, provided that the retail-
er shall have a margin of profit of not less than 10 per cent nor more
than 15 per cent over the operating expenses."
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of May, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1449
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
